title: Bullying
meaning: Repeated unkind behaviour meant to hurt, scare or exclude someone, often where the other person has more power or is hard to stop.
examples_and_warning_signs: Name-calling, mocking or teasing again and again
Being left out or having rumours spread
Pushing, or taking or damaging your belongings
Not wanting to go to school, or changes in sleep and mood
steps: Stay calm. It is not your fault.
Write down dates, what happened and who saw it.
Tell a trusted adult: a parent, class teacher or counsellor.
Stay near friends or staff in places where it happens.
Ask your school about its anti-bullying process.
seek_immediate_help: Someone is hurting you or threatens serious harm
You are thinking of harming yourself
